name: Umang Pansuriya
intro: I build mobile, WebGL and PC games in Unity. Over 4 years I have shipped puzzle, tycoon and multiplayer titles, and I care most about clean architecture and smooth performance on low-end devices.
summary: Senior Unity Game Developer with 4+ years of experience architecting and shipping production mobile titles, WebGL games, and real-time multiplayer systems. Specialized in ScriptableObject-driven architecture, decoupled event-driven systems, and modular Assembly Definitions. I optimize runtime performance (draw calls, memory, garbage collection) and build reliable client-server networking and Addressables pipelines.

skills.items: Unity (2D/3D, URP, HDRP), C#, .NET, Unity Profiler, Frame Debugger
ScriptableObject architecture, event-driven systems, state machines, object pooling, asmdefs
Socket.IO / WebSockets, REST APIs, session management, Addressables, In-App Purchases, game analytics
Android, iOS, WebGL (CrazyGames, Poki), Git, multi-platform build and release
AI tooling for prototyping, boilerplate, profiling analysis and documentation

points: Solo-developed Stack Master, a grid-based match-3 puzzle game, end to end using ScriptableObjects and event signals.
Built extensible 2D grid placement and progression systems for Spirit World, and integrated remote Addressables catalogs to cut base build size.
Made a gameplay prototype and a custom Unity Editor level-design toolset for Arrow Puzzle.
Fixed platform-specific bugs and input issues on live CrazyGames and Poki builds.
Programmed the tycoon loops, room upgrades, save system and draw-call optimization for Queen Hotel Simulator.
Implemented Socket.IO and REST networking for Teen Patti and Roulette: turn sync, sessions and reconnection.
Built puzzle state machines and interactions, HDRP lighting and audio for the horror prototype Whispers in the Woods.
Developed a .NET bridge for real-time data exchange between hardware peripherals and servers.
